# Tokyo Dome, 2nd floor (D rows 1-10, E rows 11 on): each block's rows read
# off くるみっこ's detailed charts (kurumicat.com dome2f-*.png; the PDF version
# is pictures, so these are typed in from them). One block a line:
#   BLOCK rows:first-last[,first-last] ...
# e.g. "D11 1-8:301-312 9-10:301-313" is rows 1-8 seats 301-312, rows 9-10
# seats 301-313. A row the chart ends early with an "x" is its seats as far
# as the chart numbers them. Sky terrace boxes in D rows 8-9 are left out of
# the seats (their own runs where the chart gives them).
# The end blocks were checked against pages 3 and 6 of
# https://kurumicat.com/wp-content/uploads/2f-01-51.pdf
